def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full lines of one color form separators in these tiled marker puzzles.
    sr = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb, cb = [-1] + sr + [h], [-1] + sc + [w]
    panels=[]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        row=[]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            vals=[grid[y][x] for y in range(rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]) for x in range(cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1])]
            row.append(vals)
        panels.append(row)
    # Divider colors are the values on full separator lines.
    divcolors={grid[r][0] for r in sr} | {grid[0][c] for c in sc}
    allvals=[v for row in panels for panel in row for v in panel]
    freq=Counter(v for v in allvals if v not in divcolors)
    background=freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=max((v for v in freq if v != background), key=lambda v: freq[v], default=None)
    out=[]
    for row in panels:
        outrow=[]
        for vals in row:
            count=vals.count(marker) if marker is not None else 0
            outrow.append(1 if count==2 else background)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
